svg.aria-label: Isometric illustration for AI product and developer tool design. On a dotted floor stands a white desk. On it lies a low blue keyboard with white keys and one lime Enter key, pressed by a developer marked with code brackets who stands at the desk's end. Behind the keyboard, laid flat on the desk, is the first result: a white sheet marked AI, with a line of code and three ticked checks the model ran. A reviewer marked with a tick stands behind the desk with a hand on the sheet's sign-off button.
